fact: The online police clearance platform was developed by Liberia Revenue Authority programmers, and the LRA's Management Information Services Division described it as showing local professionals' technical expertise.
The platform developed by LRA programmers was launched at Liberia National Police Headquarters on Friday 1 May 2026, replacing a manual process; the document is dated 3 May.
The Liberia Revenue Authority says its own tech team built and launched the Online Duty-Free Application Platform.
